text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a maelstrom of fervor and excitement, the curtain falls on the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The entire crowd celebrates the moment that <chrname> is crowned the greatest racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I also receive effusive praise and thorough coverage from Reporter Otonashi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The proof of <chrname>'s strength gleams brilliantly, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We vow to keep striving for ever greater heights on our journey together!
